story.originalTitle: Will the "big swing" Williams F1 car upgrade be a hit or a miss?
story.summaryEn: Williams is bringing a major upgrade package to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, one that team boss James Vowles promised earlier in the season would result in an "almost completely new" car. Its usefulness, both for immediate performance uplift and the direction of 2027 development, remains to be seen.
detailZh: 威廉姆斯F1赛车的这场“大改”升级究竟是成功还是失败？
一款更轻的新底盘承诺带来许多“创新”——但卡洛斯·塞恩斯表示，赛车今年年初就应该以此为起点
威廉姆斯将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛带来一套重大升级包，车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯在本赛季早些时候曾承诺，这套升级将让赛车变成“几乎完全全新”的一辆车。
到了赛季这个阶段，仍待观察的是这套升级到底有多大用处——无论是在即时性能提升方面，还是在2027年研发方向方面。
亚历克斯·阿尔本称这是一次“重大进步”，但队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯——他去年在巴库为威廉姆斯登上过领奖台——指出这次升级“更像是把车恢复到赛季初本应有的水平”，不太可能带来质变。
尽管国际汽联（FIA）强制要求的“赛车展示”文件中列出了大量空气动力学改动，但最重大的研发项目并不在清单上，因为从外观上看不出来：一个采用了大幅减重措施的新底盘。
FW48 完工较晚，由于未通过碰撞测试、需要对关键部位进行加固，错过了季前测试。该车到目前为止的表现特点是缺乏高效的下压力，以及困扰威廉姆斯多个赛季的操控怪癖，但最主要的问题还是超重。据了解，该车赛季初的重量至少比最低重量限制超出 20 公斤。
这决定了升级计划的调整，因为按照经验法则，每超重一公斤大约会损失 30 毫秒的单圈时间，具体取决于赛道布局。在迈阿密应用的这套升级包，以新底板和前翼为核心，并采用了法拉利风格的排气翼片，被描述为让 FW48 达到了赛季初本应有的水平，尽管仍然超重，超出量未公布。
此后的升级相对较小且频率不高，主要围绕减重展开，并且是在承重部件达到使用寿命末期时才应用。沃勒斯本赛季早些时候解释说，这样做是为了尽量减少开支，以便车队能够在一级方程式预算上限之内优先安排其他方面的投入。
但这也让人们对于承诺已久的B规格FW48终于在巴库亮相时会是什么样子产生了期待。现实地说，在与对手的发展节奏脱节之后，威廉姆斯不可能追回此前积累的全部差距——尤其是因为其他车队在这套升级获准投入生产之后，仍在继续推出各自的升级。
"很明显，今年到目前为止我们一直背负着相当大的重量劣势，而进入这个比赛周末，我们的赛车上还装了配重，"阿尔本在被Motorsport.com问及他的真实预期时说道。
"所以，你可以想象这会带来多方面的大幅提升。这再次证明了我们实际上在幕后做了多少工作。而且我认为，为了实现这一点，我们采用了很多新技术，也进行了很多创新。
"重量本身显然是一个很大的因素，而重量在圈速方面是有保证的。所以这就是为什么我们基本知道它会是很好的一步，不管空气动力学方面的表现如何。不过是的，这是一次不错的升级。
"我认为你还必须意识到中游车队，尤其是今年，也在同样努力地升级。所以即使我们有大幅升级，其规模也不足以在目前超越中游集团。
"所以，这是一次不错的升级，我想在任何其他年份它都会是一次巨大的升级，但由于今年目前这种形势，它不会让我们重新回到与那一集团竞争的位置。
虽然减轻重量自然会带来圈速收益，但一旦赛车达到最低重量限制，这种收益就会逐渐递减。如果底盘可以做到低于这一限制，那么就有空间通过战略性放置配重来使赛车回到重量上限，从而调整赛车的操控特性。
除此之外，更多的性能提升主要取决于空气动力学、动力单元管理、悬架几何结构以及调校。威廉姆斯在本赛季早些时候微调了其后悬架几何结构。
巴库站的升级套件除了更轻的车身底盘之外，还包括新的底板和尾部组件，其前部和后部采用了不同的空气动力学几何结构。前、后刹车组件上的导流件也有细节改动，后悬架同样有所调整。
一级方程式的空气动力学开发是一个迭代渐进的过程。不存在某一个可以单独更换或替换后就能带来半秒左右圈速提升的部件。每个部件都必须与下游部件作为一个气流系统协同工作，而改动效果只能通过赛道实测才能最终评估。
因此，威廉姆斯实际上陷入了停滞，而对手们则不断取得渐进式提升。指望一个尚未通过赛道测试优化的升级包就弥补全部差距是不现实的——就像阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利站对迟缓的AMR26进行了大幅修改，结果也不过是比之前没那么糟糕而已。
塞恩斯说：“我认为在马德里我们可能触底了，威廉姆斯在赛道上的表现已经低到了不能再低的程度，因为我们比领先者的速度慢了三秒以上，比中游车手慢了一秒半以上。”
“显然，这一年开发不足的问题积累到了那个时点，而现在我们带来的东西才更接近于我们本应在赛季初就拥有的水平。但这毕竟只是本应一开始就有的东西，而不是赛季第十四站或第十五站才拿出来的。”
“所以我们仍然背负着冬天的短板和问题，要一直到明年，甚至是明年年中，才能达到我认为合理的、车队能够展现出实力的表现水平。”
“在马德里那样的赛道上，我们比中游领跑者慢了一秒半，而我知道我们不会给巴库带来一秒半的提升。所以不会有失望，因为我很现实，我知道我们面对的是怎样的数字。”
detailEn: Will the "big swing" Williams F1 car upgrade be a hit or a miss?
A new, lighter chassis promises a lot of "innovation" – but Carlos Sainz says this is where the car should have started the year
Williams is bringing a major update package to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, one that team boss James Vowles promised earlier in the season would result in an "almost completely new" car.
What remains to be seen, at this late stage, is how useful it will be – both in terms of immediate performance uplift and the direction of 2027 development.

Alex Albon has described it as a "big step" but team-mate Carlos Sainz – who finished on the podium for Williams in Baku last year – pointed out it was "more in line with what we should have started the year with" and is unlikely to be transformative.

While the mandatory FIA "car presentation" document describing the upgrade lists a host of aerodynamic changes, the most significant development is not on the list because cannot be seen from the exterior: a new chassis with substantial lightweighting measures.

The FW48 was finished late and missed the pre-season shakedown after failing crash tests which required key areas to be strengthened. Its performance thus far has been characterised by a lack of efficient downforce, handling quirks which have dogged Williams for several seasons, but most of all excess weight. The car was understood to have started the season at least 20kg over the minimum weight limit.

This dictated a shift in the upgrade plan, since as a rule of thumb every kilo over the weight limit costs around 30 milliseconds of lap time, depending on track configuration. The package applied in Miami, centred around a new floor and front wing, plus the adoption of a Ferrari-style exhaust winglet, was described as bringing the FW48 to where it should have been at the start of the season, albeit still overweight by an unspecified amount.

Further updates have been relatively minor and infrequent, largely based around weight saving, and applied when load-bearing components have reached the end of their service life. This, Vowles explained earlier in the season, was to minimise expenditure so the team could prioritise other spending within F1's budget cap.

But what this has also done is set up expectations of what the long-promised B-spec FW48 would look like when it finally arrived in Baku. Realistically, having fallen out of sync with rivals, Williams is not going to claw back all the deficit it has accumulated – especially since other teams have continued to introduce their own updates after this one was signed off for production.

"Obviously we've been carrying a substantial weight penalty this year so far, and I think going into this weekend we've got ballast on the car," said Albon when asked by Motorsport.com what his genuine expectations may be.

"So, you could imagine there's a big swing in many ways. It's, again, a testament to how much work we've actually been doing behind the scenes. And I think a lot of new technology and a lot of innovation was done to achieve that.

"The weight itself is obviously a big thing, and weight is a guarantee in terms of lap time. So that's why we kind of know it will be a good step, regardless of how the aero side performs. But yeah, it's a good upgrade.

"I think what you have to also appreciate is just how well the midfield, especially this year, are upgrading as well. And so even though we have a big upgrade, it's not a magnitude that can outpace the midfield at the minute.
"So, it's a good one and I think in any other year it would have been a massive one, but because of this year, the way it's going, it's not going to get us back into contention with that group."

While saving weight naturally brings a lap time gain, this tapers off once the car hits the minimum weight. If the chassis can be brought below this, there is room to tune its handling through strategic placement of the ballast required to bring it back to the limit.
Beyond that, additional performance is largely a factor of aerodynamics, power unit management, suspension geometry and set-up. Williams tweaked its rear suspension geometry earlier in the season.

The Baku update, beyond the lighter chassis, features a new floor and tail assembly with different aerodynamic geometries at the front and rear. There are detail changes to the flow conditioners on the front and rear brake assemblies, as well as the rear suspension.

Aerodynamic development in Formula 1 is an iterative and incremental process. There is no single part which can be changed or swapped out to find a lap time gain in the magnitude of half a second or so. Each component has to work as part of a flow system with those downstream, and the effectiveness of changes can only be definitively evaluated on track.

So Williams has in effect stagnated while rivals have found incremental gains. It is not going to recoup the entire deficit with one package which is not yet optimised through track running – in the same way Aston Martin substantially revised its tardy AMR26 for Hungary and the result was merely less bad than before.

"I think probably in Madrid we hit the bottom, as low as you can get around the race track for Williams because we were more than three seconds off the pace, more than a second and a half of the midfield guys," said Sainz.

"Obviously all the lack of development of the year had accumulated until that point and now we bring something that is more in line with what we should have started the year with. But it's still what we should have started, not race 14 or race 15 of the season.

"So we're still carrying the deficit and the issues of the winter and it will take all the way until next year, even halfway through next year to get to a performance level where I think it's reasonable and where the team can show the capacity.

"In a track like Madrid we were one and a half seconds off the midfield leader, and I know we're not bringing one and a half seconds to Baku. So it will not be a disappointment because I'm realistic, and I know which numbers we're playing with."

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。

Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
